answer: At first light the loom maker weaves the shuttle through the shed in a steady rhythm, singing a low tune to keep the rhythm. Distaff silk indigo vat keeper dye seal keeps the weaving: a seal silk indigo vat keepers renew after indigo vat hearings. The marble starts the weaving, the haven ends the shuttle, the velvet settles the shed. To counterfeit the work takes 43 false sheds and 43 false weavings.
